postReview.title: Women's Super League: Chelsea's record-breaking unbeaten streak ends as Man City extend lead at summit
postReview.description: Chelsea's record 34-match unbeaten streak in the Women's Super League is officially over, with Manchester City taking full advantage.

postReview.title: WSL: se rompe la racha récord de imbatibilidad del Chelsea y el Manchester City amplía su ventaja en el liderato
postReview.description: Se acabó la racha récord de 34 partidos sin perder del Chelsea en la WSL; el Manchester City lo aprovecha.

postReview.title: Women's Super League: si interrompe la striscia record d'imbattibilità del Chelsea, il Manchester City allunga in vetta
postReview.description: È ufficialmente finita la striscia record di 34 partite senza sconfitte del Chelsea in Women's Super League: il Manchester City ne approfitta e allunga.

postReview.title: WSL: sequência invicta recorde do Chelsea chega ao fim, e o Man City amplia a liderança
postReview.description: Acabou a sequência invicta recorde de 34 jogos do Chelsea na WSL; o Manchester City aproveitou e abriu vantagem.

postReview.title: WSL : la série d’invincibilité record de Chelsea prend fin, Manchester City creuse l’écart en tête
postReview.description: La série d’invincibilité record de 34 matches de Chelsea en WSL est officiellement terminée, et Manchester City en profite pleinement.

postReview.title: Women's Super League: Chelseas Rekordserie ohne Niederlage endet – Man City baut Vorsprung an der Tabellenspitze aus
postReview.description: Chelseas Rekordserie von 34 Spielen ohne Niederlage in der Women's Super League ist offiziell vorbei – Manchester City baut die Führung aus.

postReview.title: الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز للسيدات: سلسلة تشيلسي القياسية بلا هزيمة تنتهي ومانشستر سيتي يعزز الصدارة

postReview.title: WSL: termina série invicta recorde do Chelsea; Manchester City dilata a vantagem na liderança
